narrative.overview: A purposeful dark-first interface crafted for high-contrast nighttime device control. Designed specifically as the companion app for an ESP32-powered 360-degree LED Matrix cylinder lamp.

rules.name: The Glowing Indicator Rule
rules.body: Bright neon colors are reserved strictly for active hardware states, interactive selections, and live telemetry. Inactive controls remain muted slate grey.

rules.name: The Scale Fidelity Rule
rules.body: All typography must use sp units to honor Android system font scaling and prevent clipping when accessibility text scaling is active.

rules.name: The Flat-Glow Rule
rules.body: Surfaces rest flat on the dark substrate. Depth is communicated by border luminescence and alpha tinting, not drop shadows.

dos: Do maintain dark surface backgrounds (#090D16 / #141B2D) across all screens.
Do ensure all interactive buttons and icons have a touch target of at least 48x48 dp.
Do use sp units for all text to respect Android system accessibility font scaling.
donts: Don't use pure black (#000000) or harsh un-tinted grey for card surfaces.
Don't use low-contrast text (grey text on dark blue surfaces must maintain at least 4.5:1 contrast).
Don't introduce light theme surfaces without user configuration; dark appearance is the authoritative default.
